echoParts: Now to Him who is able
than all we ask or imagine
that is at work within us
verseText: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us...
meaning: God is able to do way more than we could ever even think about asking for. His power is beyond our wildest imaginations!
